title: QA run · since:v18.4 (65/65) · 5fb79bc0 · 2026-11-12 · 42 PASS / 1 PARTIAL / 11 FAIL / 11 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czj9tecb4nj5MfUyYk

18.4.0 release acceptance, round 1, record R-184 of wave anchor #32908. Three runner subagents (effort high) dispatched by the maintainer's project session, in one cold cloud container, in parallel; text only.

**Result: 65/65 judged · 42 PASS / 1 PARTIAL / 11 FAIL / 11 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN.** No planned item. No security finding.

- The 11 FAILs are **3 product defects** (one of them behind 2 items) and **8 checklist problems** (5 assertion defects, 3 stale specs) in which the product refuses or behaves correctly. Off-clause probes found **1 more product defect**.
- The upgrade set `release-18.4.0-w1-upgrade` (first run as QA run #32093) is judged here on a real 18.3.0-written database: **3/3 PASS**. Its fix cards **#32094, #32095 and #32096 HOLD**.
- The 11 BLOCKED items carry `blocked` markers the ledger already records (no Redis multi-node gate ×6, no Oracle ×2, no SQL Server, AI chat is Cloud/EE, no locale-scoped seed). They were not driven.

## Environment fingerprint

- **Framework:** `main` @ `5fb79bc010cc9ab749dc29bfe44c83ef19f3dd11` (2026-11-12). The Console was built from `ui/` in the same tree.
- **Build:** `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 16 s; `pnpm build --concurrency=2` 119/119 tasks, 12m17s; `pnpm console:build` cache hit; `check-dev-prereqs` 107 artifacts. The showcase artifact was compiled once; every boot ran `--no-compile --no-watch` with `OS_PORT` and `OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT` exported.
- **Runners** (each its own port range and file DBs under `/tmp`):
  - R3 browser half, ports 41550–41554.
  - R4 API half, ports 41570–41576. Scratch packages `com.qa.addr-a` (`qa_a`), `com.qa.addr-b` (`qa_b`), `com.qa.decl` installed into a scratch copy of the showcase; a runner-authored mock OIDC IdP on 41575.
  - R5 package / cli / upgrade half, ports 41590–41606. Route (a): npm `create-objectstack@18.3.0` blank scaffold run by `@objectstack/cli@18.3.0` to write the golden DB (sha256 `7658e190…`, telemetry `dbfb8a34…`); the tree's CLI (`packages/cli/bin/run.js`) booted copies of it.
- **Deviations:** R3 served six items from one DB after a Playwright OOM; R4 used one DB per boot, not per item, for items sharing a fixture. A container restart at about 23:25Z killed every process; captured verdicts were kept and unfinished pins and boots re-run.
- **Hygiene:** every port free at the end; `git status` clean; no `installed-packages` in the tree.
- **Time:** 23:14Z → 00:03Z. Roughly 1 : 2 environment to testing.

## Scope

Selector `since:v18.4`, resolved with `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs since:v18.4 --json --include-blocked` at `5fb79bc0`: 54 runnable + 11 blocked. Revisions are in the verdict list below.

## Tier 1 pins (rule 6)

Every `automated.ref` pin ran at `5fb79bc0`, flock-serialised, one package per invocation, `--maxWorkers=1`. **0 failures.**

- R3: 24 `ui/` files, 298/298 (component layer, jsdom).

- R5: cli 247, spec 182, objectql 415, objectql-local 19, metadata-protocol 26, runtime 46, cloud-connection 24, service-automation 43, plugin-email 104, plugin-webhooks 26, service-analytics 25, service-datasource 37, driver-sql 71, service-push 38, service-messaging 33, ui 155.

## Reproduction rules (every FAIL)

**F-1 · records-forms.multi-currency-invoice clause 5, records-forms.home-amount-preview-states clause 0 · product defect.**
1. Fresh showcase boot; sign in as admin through the form.
2. Open the record page of invoice INV-1004 (EUR 450, invoice date 2026-11-12). The detail page shows "Converted at 0.9 on Nov 12, 2026" (correct).
3. Click Edit and count `[data-testid=home-amount-preview]` in the dialog. **Expected** 1, data-state `converted`. **Actual** 0: "Total incl. Tax" is drawn as plain text `€450.00`.
4. Switch Currency to JPY and Invoice Date to 2026-01-15: still 0 preview lines.

Reproduced twice in fresh browser contexts. Mechanism (read at `5fb79bc0`): the invoice `amount` carries an `expression` (`examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/invoice.object.ts`); since #31759 `ObjectForm` marks an expression-computed field `readonly` (`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx`, `isExpressionComputedField`); `CurrencyField`'s read-only branch returns before `HomeAmountPreview`, which is mounted only on the editable branch (`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/CurrencyField.tsx`). The preview itself works: on an editable record-mode amount (scratch object) all four states `same`, `converted`, `awaitingDate`, `awaitingRate` drew live. Traps ruled out: stale-console-bundle (built from this tree), hydration-race, automation-input, seed-data-thin.

**F-2 · ai.mcp-tool-call-interceptor clause 5 · product defect.**
1. Scratch copy of `examples/app-showcase` whose config adds the item's inline `qa-mcp-interceptor` plugin (it `console.log`s one `[qa-interceptor] {…}` line per tool call).
2. Mint an `osk_` key; `objectstack start --no-ui -p PORT -d file:DB` with `OS_MCP_STDIO_ENABLED=true` and `OS_MCP_STDIO_API_KEY=KEY`.
3. Over stdin: initialize, notifications/initialized, `tools/call` list_objects, delete_record, describe_object; capture stdout and stderr in full.

**Expected** a `[qa-interceptor] … "transport":"stdio"` line on stderr. **Actual** the seam runs (delete_record → PERMISSION_DENIED 'QA interceptor refuses delete_record'; describe_object → INTERNAL_ERROR plus the MCP WARN on stderr) but the plugin's line appears on neither stream. Control: the same copy and DB under `os start` over HTTP prints the line on stderr. 3 reproductions (SDK stdio client once, raw pipe twice).

**F-3 · studio-authoring.dataset-member-vocabulary clause 6 · product defect.**
1. `PUT /api/v1/meta/dataset/qa_vocab_metrics` with measure `invoice_count` carrying `synonyms: ['bill count','账单数']` and a `description`; read-back 200 returns both.
2. Sign in through the form; open `/_console/studio/~all/metadata/dataset/qa_vocab_metrics`; expand the measure row's Advanced.

**Expected** Synonyms, Description and the help text "At most 20, each at most 60 characters". **Actual** Name, Aggregate, Field, Label, Display format, Filter, Derived only. 3 reproductions (two Studio loads, plus the Setup route). Mechanism: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/index.ts` registers `DatasetDefaultInspector` for `dataset`, which replaces the spec's `datasetForm` (`packages/spec/src/ui/dataset.form.ts` declares the fields) and renders no synonym or member-description control.

**F-4 · access-security.permission-set-address-in-execution-context clause 2 · assertion defect.**
Install qa_a (holds permission set `qa_a_reader`) and qa_b (holds none); grant member M `qa_a_reader`; stop; insert `sys_metadata_activation (metadata_type 'permission', name 'qa_a_reader', package_id 'com.qa.addr-b', active 0)`; restart; as M `GET /api/v1/auth/me/permissions`. **Expected (clause)** `qa_a_reader` still listed. **Actual** dropped; data read 403; explain `held — deactivated`; boot WARN that the reference names a package that no longer serves it. 2 fresh restarts. `com.qa.addr-b` is not a holder, so the row is a stale column the rule deliberately reads as the holder's switch (`packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts`, `ledgerRowHolders`, #31698). The true two-holder case is pinned by `permission-set-address.test.ts` (passed). The clause's fixture cannot stand for "another holder".

**F-5 · ai.mcp-read-file-pdf-word-extraction clause 4 · assertion defect (pending a ruling).**
Boot with `OS_MCP_READ_FILE_CPU_BUDGET_MS=1`; MCP `read_file {objectName: showcase_invoice_line, recordId: a line whose receipt is a 180-page PDF, field: receipt}`. **Expected** facts `truncated: true` + the budget note. **Actual** facts `content: "none"`, the note "Reading stopped at the CPU-time budget for one file (1 ms) after page 0 …", no `truncated`, no text block (also on a 2-page PDF). With `=60` the same call answers text, `truncated: true` and the note (2 runs). At 1 ms no page completes and `pdfAnswer` (`packages/mcp/src/file-content.ts`) answers an empty read as `kind: 'none'`. Re-point the fixture at a budget that reads one page, or rule that a stopped read always carries `truncated: true` (then it is a product defect in that arm).

**F-6 · cli.deploy-runtime-dry-run-json clause 4 · assertion defect.**
Deploy `com.qa.deploy` 1.0.0 whose field `note` holds data in 2 rows; build 1.1.0 dropping `note`; `os deploy --dry-run`, then `os deploy --json` off a TTY. **Expected** "would stop" and a refusal carrying the confirm command. **Actual** the plan says the column is not dropped and nothing asks for confirmation; `--json` installs. Control: a rename (`name` → `title`, v1.2.0) does stop: `--json` exits 1, result refused, 409 SCHEMA_UPGRADE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED, with `os deploy --confirm-upgrade schema-upgrade:…`. The fixture should use a rename or a type change.

**F-7 · platform-core.namespace-co-owner-name-refusal clause 2 (stale spec), clause 3 (assertion defect).**
- Clause 2: install-local `com.qa.n-one` (namespace `qa_n`, page `qa_board`), then `com.qa.n-two` (same namespace, page `qa_board`). **Expected** 422 naming page qa_board and both packages. **Actual** without a dependency, 422 PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED from namespace ownership ("namespace "qa_n" is already owned by …"); with one, 403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE (ADR-0146 D2) naming page/qa_board and both packages. Nothing installs either way; the clause's refusal is unreachable from this door. 2 reproductions.
- Clause 3: a `packages[]` stack with a residual top-level page `qa_board` under `qa_n`; `os validate` exits 0. `packages/objectql/src/namespace-co-owner-names.ts` documents that validate/build do not judge the residual; the registry pin (56/56) does.

**F-8 · platform-core.namespace-object-name-refusal clause 3 · assertion defect.**
Package `com.qa.w` with a draft object clashing with a namespace. `POST /api/v1/packages/com.qa.w/publish` → 200 `success:false` "No metadata items found" (that door publishes package items, not drafts). `POST /api/v1/packages/com.qa.w/publish-drafts` → 200, outcome refused, `failed[0].code` NAMESPACE_CONFLICT, draft kept. **Expected (clause)** 422. The refusal is real; the clause names the wrong route and status (`protocol.namespace-object-name-doors.test.ts` expects the 200 per-item refusal). 2 reproductions.

**F-9 · api-backend.actions-namespace-address clause 1 · stale spec.**
Install qa_a (object `qa_a_ticket`, embedded action `escalate`) and qa_b (standalone `escalate` bound to `qa_a_ticket` via `objectExtensions`); `POST /api/v1/actions/qa_a_ticket/escalate/RID {}`. **Expected (clause)** qa_a's result. **Actual** 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT naming both packages (2 reproductions); with qa_b's escalate removed, 200 qa_a's result. #31697 landed (ruling record 6729825528, letter A; `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`, `pickActionHolder`). Negative 3 still calls that refusal unlanded.

**F-10 · platform-core.bare-name-one-holder-refusal clauses 1 and 4 · stale spec.**
Install qa_a (flow `qa_sync`), then qa_b (other namespace, flow `qa_sync`). **Expected** 422 naming both. **Actual** 200; the bare address answers 409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT naming both, and a cold restart warns nothing because no clash exists. Flow joined the namespace-scoped bare-name types (#31696, `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`). 2 reproductions (two boots). The clauses need a type that is still one-holder.

## Off-clause probes (rule 8)

About 17 runner-minutes in all, after the clauses had verdicts, on the same boots. Personas: admin, plain members, contributor-bound member, anonymous.
- R3 (~6 min): recycle-bin doors (member 403, anonymous 401, unknown/empty/wrong-object entry 404, double restore 404, sys_ bin 400); list-link filter boundaries; 2FA challenged-sign-in token; Studio autosave on partly picked home-amount pointers. Nothing filed.
- R4 (~6 min): meta/actions/automation/activation doors with uppercase namespace, empty trailing segment, unknown names, `_env` against an object action, activation door as member; dataset tool limits. **Found P-1** (below).
- R5 (~5 min): dataset vocabulary boundaries (21 synonyms, 60/61 chars, 500/501 description, folded duplicates); `migrate stored-references bind` with unknown or injection-shaped table, trailing-quote id, non-candidate and empty package. Nothing filed.

**P-1 · ai.mcp-dataset-tools · observed beside the clauses · product defect.** MCP `query_dataset {datasetName: showcase_invoice_metrics, selection: {measures: [invoice_count], dimensions: [status], limit: 1}}` → `rows` 1, `drillRawRows` 2, `truncated` true; `limit: 2` → rows 2, drillRawRows 3. Reproduced twice. `packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-tools.ts` asks for `cap + 1` rows and slices `rows` to the cap, but spreads `...rest` untrimmed, so the index-aligned `drillRawRows` keeps the probe row and the arrays misalign.

## Checklist-accuracy notes and fixture gaps (for anchor #32908, not extracted)

- ai.mcp-read-file-pdf-word-extraction: the `receipt` file field is on `showcase_invoice_line`, not `showcase_invoice`.
- access-security.ai-service-account-agent-ceiling steps 1, 3: `/auth/me/permissions` is session-only; re-point to admin `POST /security/explain`.
- access-security.permission-set-package-resolution step 3: once qa_b depends on qa_a, its same-named items are refused 403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE (ADR-0146 D2); the shared fixture must rename them.
- identity-auth.idp-group-permission-set-mapping step 4: a hand-made grant of the same set to the same user collides (409 UNIQUE_VIOLATION) with the marked grant. A 40-line node mock OIDC IdP closes the "no stock IdP" gap; the SSO user must be invited (invite_only refuses JIT).
- api-backend.automation-namespace-address: the 405 `Allow` is `GET, HEAD`.
- identity-auth.scim-refused-audit-row: an unverified bearer's bucket is keyed by client address, so other refusals from the same peer share the 20.
- access-security.credential-use-audit-row: address and UA are row columns, not metadata keys.
- api-backend.client-sdk-namespace-address: the pin holds 83 tests (item says 79).
- records-forms.delete-toast-undo-restore: the showcase project list draws no bulk Delete (its view declares `bulkActionDefs`); the bulk leg ran on `showcase_inquiry`.
- records-forms.action-preflight-panel: the fixture needs an object on the default record page (`task-detail.page.ts` lists header actions by id).
- studio-authoring.currency-home-amount-editor: a fixed-mode decoy uses `defaultCurrency`; `currency` is refused 422.
- identity-auth.console-two-factor-prompt-phone-doors: the two-factor step draws no title (`hideHeader`); the SMS code is logged only at `--log-level info`.
- identity-auth.console-sign-out-and-ended-session: a member lands on the default app page, not `/home`.
- platform-core.stored-reference-package-backfill-upgrade: C4's by-design differences omit the `sys_inbox_message` narrowing; the R3 fixture must be a decided suggestion.
- platform-core.activation-ledger-package-key-upgrade observations: a stray `[sql-driver] DATABASE_ERROR … no such column: permission_set_package` on a pre-upgrade `migrate plan`; a raw UNIQUE DATABASE_ERROR before the friendly ERROR on the conflict boot; "1 row(s) name no package" while 4 rows name none.
- integration-system.job-package-key: needs `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=1`.
- studio-authoring.currency-field-repointed-refusal: `homeAmount` belongs inside `currencyConfig`.
- cli.address-grammar-reserved-names C4: `os dev` refuses at compile; use `serve --dev`.
- cli.validate-target-restriction-profile C2: the permissive profile must list `approval` and `approval_revise`.
- integration-system.push-device-registry-and-relay-boot C6: the `[messaging] channel provider registered: push` line prints unconditionally.
- The QA run #32093 item-text findings 1–7 are all fixed in the current revisions.

The full per-clause tables follow as comments, one per runner.
